summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $4.20/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $4.20 a gallon across Wisconsin as of October 31, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 23¢ lower than a week ago, 4¢ higher than a month ago, and $1.53 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Eau Claire ($3.93) and the highest in Mosinee ($4.49).
